info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Ferrier Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Ferrier Battery Detail Management API enables users to efficiently manage and create detailed records for Ferrier battery catalog items. This API serves manufacturers, retailers, and maintenance services focusing on battery inventory by streamlining the process of adding and updating battery specifications. It empowers businesses to keep their catalog up-to-date, ensure product compliance, and enhance inventory accuracy. Users can integrate this API into their systems to enhance their operational capabilities and improve battery management workflows.

post.summary: Create or update details for Ferrier battery.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create or update the details of a Ferrier battery in the system. It is designed to handle both new entries and updates to existing battery details, ensuring that the information remains current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit detailed information regarding the Ferrier battery. Ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly to process the request successfully.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested battery details.
